blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 155 in June to 131 in October (−15.5%), and it took 16.7% of the city’s 294 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 198 in June to 189 in October (−4.5%), and it took 25.4% of the city’s 456 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out White Rock for detached houses in June, July, September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in October (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in White Rock than in June?
faq.a: In White Rock, listings of houses fell from 155 in June to 131 in October (−15.5%); condos and townhomes fell from 198 in June to 189 in October (−4.5%).

faq.q: How big is White Rock compared with the rest of South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: In October 2026, White Rock held 23.0% of the 570 houses listed in South Surrey and White Rock and 33.7% of the 561 condos and townhomes listed in South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: How many homes sold in White Rock from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 49 houses and 116 condos and townhomes sold in White Rock over those 5 months.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in White Rock?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
